findings.title: Mongoose 7.24
findings.summary_md: Cesanta published Mongoose 7.24 with a security-fix list that includes built-in TCP/IP FIN packet payload handling, IPv4 and IPv6 fragment handling, and IPv6 extension-header checksum validation. The same release lists WebSocket, HTTP, TLS, PPP, and mbedTLS hardening plus a fix tracked as CVE-2026-106024. This is the upstream release that carries the MIP FIN-payload repair later detailed in GHSA-4mgp-8m9m-q872.

findings.title: ZDI-CAN-29386: MIP Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
findings.summary_md: Cesanta and Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative published GHSA-4mgp-8m9m-q872 for ZDI-CAN-29386, rating the MIP heap overflow CVSS 3.1 9.8 with no CVE identifier assigned. The advisory says a TCP FIN carrying payload makes read_conn() in net_builtin.c skip the receive-buffer resize check and reach a memcpy, giving an attacker control over the overflow size, content, and write offset. Version 7.23 was tested, versions up to 7.23 are listed as affected, and 7.24 is the patched version. The proof of concept sends 400 bytes of normal data into the default 512-byte MG_IO_SIZE receive buffer, then a FIN carrying 400 bytes of payload, overflowing by 288 bytes.
